title: The fix that kept disappearing
instructions:
Situation: someone fixed props.conf  directly on a server. Every night it reverts.
Work out what's overwriting it (the nightly Ansible run from the repo).
Put the fix in the repo, through a PR, so Ansible deploys it instead of undoing it.
Done when: after the next nightly run the fix is still there.
Learn: with automation, the repo is the source of truth. Manual edits on servers get
erased.
completionScope: Engine checks establish workflow milestones; review the manual success criteria and debrief for outcomes beyond these checks.

setup.title: Nightly configuration convergence
setup.text:
- hosts: heavy_forwarders
  become: true
  tasks:
    - name: Enforce source parsing
      copy:
        dest: /opt/splunk/etc/system/local/props.conf
        content: "[fgt_traffic]\nSHOULD_LINEMERGE = true\n"
